import Ern
open Lean Meta Elab Command
elab "#audit3" : command => do
  let env ← getEnv
  let mut bad := 0
  let mut n := 0
  let mut nPub := 0
  for (nm, ci) in env.constants.toList do
    let s := nm.toString
    unless (s.startsWith "Ern.Concurrency" || s.startsWith "_private.Ern.Concurrency") do continue
    unless ci matches .thmInfo _ do continue
    n := n + 1
    unless nm.isInternal do nPub := nPub + 1
    let axs ← liftCoreM <| collectAxioms nm
    let extra := axs.filter (fun a => a != ``propext && a != ``Quot.sound)
    if extra.size > 0 then
      bad := bad + 1
      IO.println s!"BAD {nm} {extra.toList}"
  IO.println s!"Concurrency theorems: {n} (non-internal {nPub}), outside propext/Quot.sound: {bad}"
  let mods := [`Ern.Concurrency.ArenaPreserve, `Ern.Concurrency.ArenaConservativity, `Ern.Concurrency.RealizeSound,
    `Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.MX, `Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.AR, `Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.Frames,
    `Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.S10, `Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.Witness]
  for mn in mods do
    let mut m := 0
    let mut mp := 0
    for (nm, ci) in env.constants.toList do
      unless ci matches .thmInfo _ do continue
      let some idx := env.getModuleIdxFor? nm | continue
      unless env.header.moduleNames[idx.toNat]! == mn do continue
      m := m + 1
      unless nm.isInternal do mp := mp + 1
    IO.println s!"{mn}: {m} theorems ({mp} non-internal)"
#audit3
----
import Lean
import Ern.MemoryModel.Arena
import Ern.MemoryModel.RefinementArena
open Lean Meta Elab Command
elab "#auditArena" : command => do
  let env ← getEnv
  for mn in [`Ern.MemoryModel.Arena, `Ern.MemoryModel.RefinementArena] do
    let mut n := 0
    let mut nPub := 0
    let mut bad := 0
    for (nm, ci) in env.constants.toList do
      unless ci matches .thmInfo _ do continue
      let some idx := env.getModuleIdxFor? nm | continue
      unless env.header.moduleNames[idx.toNat]! == mn do continue
      n := n + 1
      unless nm.isInternal do nPub := nPub + 1
      let axs ← liftCoreM <| collectAxioms nm
      let extra := axs.filter (fun a => a != ``propext && a != ``Quot.sound)
      if extra.size > 0 then
        bad := bad + 1
        IO.println s!"BAD {nm} {extra.toList}"
    IO.println s!"{mn}: theorems {n} (non-internal {nPub}), outside propext/Quot.sound: {bad}"
#auditArena

/-- **Theorem 7** (Spec 1 §55; WC4 C19, C23): every labelled step, the arena operations included,
preserves `ArenaInvC` (`ArenaInv` of every live entry of the arena registry, with the auxiliaries
of `Arena.LInv`), when the state before satisfies `WF3` and the state after `NoDangling` (both
supplied by theorem 2). Fragment: every labelled step, interleaved at the grain of abstract
steps. -/
theorem lstep_arenaInv {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (hw : WF3 st.1.flat) (hnd : NoDangling st'.1.flat)
    (hi : ArenaInvC st.1 st.2.2) : ArenaInvC st'.1 st'.2.2 := by
  have hkp := lstep_keep h
  have keep : st'.2.2 = st.2.2 → ArenaInvC st'.1 st'.2.2 := fun e => by
    unfold ArenaInvC; rw [e]; exact lInv_keep hkp.1 hkp.2 hw hnd hi
  cases h
  case newArena s reg ar c st i st' h =>
    obtain ⟨-, hpre, rfl⟩ := newArenaStepC_ok h
    intro F hF
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hF with hF | hF
    · exact hi F hF
    · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hF]
----

/-- The `guarded` of a live entry belongs to the registry of live administrations of the
synchronization registry (Spec 1 §56). -/
theorem mem_liveGuardeds {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} {e : SyncEntry} (he : e ∈ reg)
    (hl : e.Live s) : e.guarded ∈ liveGuardeds s reg :=
  List.mem_map.2 ⟨e, List.mem_filter.2 ⟨he, decide_eq_true hl⟩, rfl⟩

/-- The `internal` of a live arena belongs to the registry of live administrations of the arena
registry (Spec 1 §46, §56). -/
theorem mem_liveInternals {t : S3} {ar : ArenaReg} {E : Arena.ArenaEntry} (hE : E ∈ ar)
    (hl : Arena.Live t E) : E.internal ∈ Arena.liveInternals t ar :=
  List.mem_map.2 ⟨E, List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hE, decide_eq_true hl⟩, rfl⟩

/-- `AdminSep` (Spec 1 §56; WC4 C13.7, OB-C16) is preserved by every labelled step: `newMutex`
and `newArena` check the other registry through the unified guard (WC4 C13.7, Spec 1 §76.4); no
other step registers an identity, and no step reactivates an authority (Spec 1 §42, §58), the
registered identities existing (`RegBound`, WC4 C21.6, and the bound of `ArenaInvC`). -/
theorem lstep_adminSep {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (hsep : AdminSep st.1 st.2.1 st.2.2)
    (hb : ∀ e ∈ st.2.1, e.guarded < st.1.A.length)
    (hb' : ∀ E ∈ st.2.2, E.internal < st.1.A.length) : AdminSep st'.1 st'.2.1 st'.2.2 := by
  have hA := (lstep_keep h).1
  have back : ∀ x, x < st.1.A.length → st'.1.flat.Active x → st.1.flat.Active x :=
    fun x hx ha => hA.active_back ha hx
  have same : st'.2.1 = st.2.1 → st'.2.2 = st.2.2 → AdminSep st'.1 st'.2.1 st'.2.2 :=
    fun e1 e2 e he E hE hl hL => by
      rw [e1] at he; rw [e2] at hE
      exact hsep e he E hE (back _ (hb e he) hl) (back _ (hb' E hE) hL)
  cases h
  case newMutex s reg ar c g st' h =>
    obtain ⟨-, hpre, rfl⟩ := h

/-- A kernel step that is neither `transfer` nor `endUse`, taken under `Encap`, preserves
`SyncState` (WC4 C21, C22, C23). -/
theorem kernel_syncState {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg} {c : Nat} {op : KernelOp}
    {s s' : SC} (h : opStepC k op c s (.ok s')) (he : Encap L (s, reg) (.kernel c op))
    (hnt : ∀ src dst, op ≠ .transfer src dst) (hne : ∀ p, op ≠ .endUse p) (hw : WF3 s.flat)
    (hw' : WF3 s'.flat) (hs : SyncState L s reg) : SyncState L s' reg :=
  facts_syncState (opStep_facts h he hnt hw) (opStep_init h hnt hne) hw hw' hs

/-- `WF3` of the globally live frames after an operation run on the view of `c` that keeps the
stack (WC4 C2). -/
theorem wf3_after_view {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {c : Nat} {s s' : SC} (hfr : FramesC s)
    (h : ViewStep (op.Step k) c s (.ok s'))
    (hW : ∀ t', op.Step k (s.view c) (.ok t') → WF3 t' ∧ t'.F = (s.view c).F) :
    WF3 s'.flat := by
  obtain ⟨t', hR, rfl⟩ := SyncPreserveAux.viewStep_ok h
  obtain ⟨hwt, hF⟩ := hW t' hR
  have hv : (s.set t').view c = t' := SC.view_set hF
  exact SC.wf3_flat_of_view (c := c) (by rw [hv]; exact hwt) hfr.nodup

/-- Theorem 4 (WC4 C21, C22, C23) on one labelled step: every labelled step taken under `Encap`
(WC4 C22.1–C22.3, C22.5), `transfer` and the by-value composite included, preserves `SyncState`
(`SyncInv`, WC4 C21.1–C21.7, and `GrantDiscipline`, WC4 C22). `KInvCA` before the step and `WF3`
after it are supplied by theorem 2. For `issue` and `reset`, whose kernel steps derive from the
`internal` of an arena (Spec 1 Part XIV), the separation of the registries `AdminSep` (Spec 1 §56,
WC4 C13.7) excludes that `internal` be the `guarded` of a live entry; it is assumed for these two
labels only. -/
theorem lstep_preserves {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (he : Encap L (st.1, st.2.1) lbl) (hk : KInvCA st.1)
    (hw' : WF3 st'.1.flat)
    (hsep : ((∃ c i r d, lbl = .issue c i r d) ∨ ∃ c i, lbl = .reset c i) →
      AdminSep st.1 st.2.1 st.2.2)
    (hs : SyncState L st.1 st.2.1) :
    SyncState L st'.1 st'.2.1 := by
  have hw : WF3 st.1.flat := hk.1.1.2
  cases h with
  | @kernel s s' reg ar c op h =>
    cases op
    case transfer src dst =>
      obtain ⟨-, h'⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h'
      exact transfer_syncState hpre.sameShape hpre.dstNotInit hpre.dstUsable.lt he hw hw' hs
    case endUse p => exact endUse_syncState h he hw hw' hs
    all_goals
----
    obtain ⟨E, s₁, -, hd, hrl, -, -⟩ := resetStepC_ok (k := k) h
    exact opStepC_preservesC hdd (opStepC_preservesC hdd hk (fun e => by cases e) hd)
      (fun e => by cases e) hrl

/-- The library invariants carried along traces: `SyncState` (theorem 4, WC4 C21, C22), the
separation of the registries `AdminSep` (Spec 1 §56; WC4 C13.7, OB-C16) and `ArenaInvC`
(theorem 7, Spec 1 §55). -/
def LibInv (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg) : Prop :=
  SyncState L st.1 st.2.1 ∧ AdminSep st.1 st.2.1 st.2.2 ∧ ArenaInvC st.1 st.2.2

/-- With an empty arena registry, `LibInv` is `SyncState` (`AdminSep` and `ArenaInvC` range over
the entries of the arena registry). -/
theorem libInv_nil {L : MutexLayout} {s : SC} {reg : SyncReg} :
    LibInv L (s, reg, []) ↔ SyncState L s reg := by
  refine ⟨fun h => h.1, fun h => ⟨h, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro e _ E hE; cases hE
  · intro E hE; cases hE

/-- Theorems 2, 4 and 7 on one labelled step taken under `Encap`: `KInvCA` and `LibInv` are
preserved, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80). -/
theorem lstep_inv {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (h : LStep k L lbl st st') (he : Encap L (st.1, st.2.1) lbl)
    (hk : KInvCA st.1) (hl : LibInv L st) : KInvCA st'.1 ∧ LibInv L st' := by
  obtain ⟨hs, hsep, ha⟩ := hl
  have hk' := lstep_kInvCA hdd h hk
  exact ⟨hk', lstep_preserves h he hk hk'.1.1.2 (fun _ => hsep) hs,
    lstep_adminSep h hsep hs.1.regBound fun E hE => (ha E hE).1,
    lstep_arenaInv h hk.1.1.2 hk'.1.2.1.2.2 ha⟩

/-- Theorems 2, 4 and 7 (WC4 C20–C23; Spec 1 §55, §56) along an `EncapsulatedTrace`: from a state
satisfying `KInvCA` and `LibInv`, every reached state satisfies both, under `DDSound` (Spec 1
§80). -/
theorem trace_inv {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbls : List Label}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L st lbls st') (hk : KInvCA st.1)
    (hs : LibInv L st) : KInvCA st'.1 ∧ LibInv L st' := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact ⟨hk, hs⟩
  | cons he hst _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨hk', hs'⟩ := lstep_inv hdd hst he hk hs
    exact ih hk' hs'

/-- Theorem 4 (WC4 C21–C23), trace form: along an `EncapsulatedTrace` from a state satisfying
`KInvCA` and `LibInv`, `SyncState` is preserved, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80). -/
theorem trace_preserves {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {lbls : List Label} (hdd : DDSound k) (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L st lbls st')
    (hk : KInvCA st.1) (hs : LibInv L st) : SyncState L st'.1 st'.2.1 :=
  (trace_inv hdd h hk hs).2.1

/-- The initial state of Spec 1 §47 as a single-context state, with empty registries (WC4 C3,
C12; Spec 1 §46), satisfies `KInvCA` and `LibInv`. -/
theorem init_inv {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (L : MutexLayout) :
    KInvCA (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics)) ∧ LibInv L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [], []) := by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hkc⟩ := reachable_single (k := k) hdd hst .init
  obtain ⟨-, haux, hh⟩ := init_kinv hst
  have hflat : (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics)).flat = S3.init statics := by
    rw [single_flat ⟨_, rfl⟩, toS3_ofS3]
  refine ⟨⟨hkc, by rw [hflat]; exact haux, by rw [hflat]; exact hh⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · intro e he; cases he
    · intro e he; cases he
    · intro e he; cases he
    · intro i j e e' ctl h; simp at h
    · intro i j e e' h; simp at h
    · intro e he; cases he
    · intro e he; cases he
    · intro e he; cases he
    · intro e he; cases he
    · intro e he; cases he
  · intro e he; cases he
  · intro E hE; cases hE

/-- Theorems 2 and 4 (WC4 C20–C23) from the initial state: every state reached from the initial
state of Spec 1 §47 (one context, empty registries) by an `EncapsulatedTrace` satisfies the
re-indexed kernel invariant `KInvC`, `SyncInv` and `GrantDiscipline`, under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80)
and well-formed statics (Spec 1 §47). -/
theorem encapsulated_inv {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {statics : Statics} {lbls : List Label}
    {st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [], []) lbls st') :
    KInvC st'.1 ∧ SyncInv L st'.1 st'.2.1 ∧ GrantDiscipline st'.1 st'.2.1 := by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := init_inv (k := k) hdd hst L
  obtain ⟨hk', hs', -⟩ := trace_inv hdd h hk hs
  exact ⟨hk'.1, hs'.1, hs'.2⟩

/-- **Theorem 7**, trace form (Spec 1 §55, §56; WC4 C19, C23): every state reached from the
initial state of Spec 1 §47 (one context, empty registries) by an `EncapsulatedTrace` satisfies
`ArenaInvC` (`ArenaInv` of every live arena) and the separation of the registries `AdminSep`,
under `DDSound` (Spec 1 §80) and well-formed statics (Spec 1 §47). -/
theorem encapsulated_arenaInv {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {statics : Statics} {lbls : List Label}
    {st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (h : EncapsulatedTrace k L (SC.ofS3 (S3.init statics), [], []) lbls st') :
    ArenaInvC st'.1 st'.2.2 ∧ AdminSep st'.1 st'.2.1 st'.2.2 := by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := init_inv (k := k) hdd hst L
  obtain ⟨-, -, hsep, ha⟩ := trace_inv hdd h hk hs
  exact ⟨ha, hsep⟩

    exact kernel_syncState hrl trivial (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ e => by cases e) hw₁ hw'
      (kernel_syncState hd hsep' (fun _ _ e => by cases e) (fun _ e => by cases e) hw hw₁ hs)

/-! ## A transfer onto a live mutex value is rejected (WC4 S18, C21.7; Spec 1 §63.3) -/

/-- WC4 S18 (C21.7 with Spec 1 §63.3): under `SyncState`, a `transfer` whose destination contains
the mutex value of a live entry is rejected, its controller leaf being `Init`. Positive twins:
`Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces.invA`, `Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces.invB`. -/
theorem transfer_into_live_mutex_rejected {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {reg : SyncReg}
    {c src dst m : Nat} {s : SC} {e : SyncEntry} (hw : WF3 s.flat) (hs : SyncState L s reg)
    (he : e ∈ reg) (hl : e.Live s) (hm : mutexOf s e.guarded = some m)
    (hmd : partOf s.P m dst) : ¬ TransferPreC k s c src dst := by
  intro hpre
  have h3 := hs.1.control e he hl
  have h4 := hs.1.ctlInit e he hl
  cases hco : ControlOf L s e with
  | none => rw [hco] at h3; exact h3
  | some ctl =>
    rw [hco] at h3 h4; simp only [OptP] at h3 h4
    obtain ⟨y, q, m', hy, hh, hm', -, hkc⟩ := SyncPreserveAux.controlOf_spec hco
    have hy' : s.A[e.guarded]? = some y := hy
    have hmm : mutexOf s e.guarded = some m' := by simp [mutexOf, hy', hh, hm']
    cases ho
    have hF : t₁.F = (s.view c).F := by obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd; rfl
    refine ⟨E, s.set t₁, hE, ⟨hl, .ok t₁, hd, rfl⟩, ?_, hnd, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨hl, .ok t₂, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [SC.view_set hF]; exact hrl

/-- Separation of the two registries of live administrations (Spec 1 §56: "An authority identity
may serve as `internal` for at most one live administrative abstraction"; WC4 C13.7, OB-C16): no
identity is at once the `guarded` of a live synchronization entry and the `internal` of a live
arena. -/
def AdminSep (s : SC) (reg : SyncReg) (ar : ArenaReg) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ reg, ∀ E ∈ ar, e.Live s → Arena.Live s.flat E → e.guarded ≠ E.internal

/-! ## Labelled steps, runs, encapsulation (WC4 C22, C23) -/

/-- Label of a step of the kernel with the synchronization library. -/
inductive Label where
  | kernel (c : Nat) (op : KernelOp)
  | spawn (c : Nat) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
  | terminate (c : Nat)
  | join (c d : Nat)
/-- Decidability of `TransferExcl` (WC4 C22.3). -/
instance (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) (src : Nat) : Decidable (TransferExcl L st src) := by
  unfold TransferExcl; infer_instance

/-- WC4 C22.3 for the transfers of the by-value composite (WC4 C23):
the source of every transfer phase satisfies `TransferExcl` in the state where that phase starts
(WC4 C5.2), the registry being `reg`. -/
def EncapVals (L : MutexLayout) (reg : SyncReg) (c : Nat) : SC → List (Nat × Nat) → Prop
  | _, [] => True
  | t, v :: vs => TransferExcl L (t, reg) v.1 ∧ EncapVals L reg c (transferEffC t c v.1 v.2) vs

/-- Encapsulation of one step in state `st` (hypothesis on traces, WC4 C22, C23): for each live
entry, WC4 C22.1 (`derive`, `split`), C22.2 (raw `deriveSync`), C22.3 (`transfer`, and the
transfer phases of the by-value composite) and C22.5 (`endUse` whose place is the controller leaf
`ctl` or a strict structural subplace of `slot`). WC4 C22.4 (controller-write protocol) is a
realization/interface obligation (WC4 C22) with no content in `S_C`, which has no values (Spec 1
§41), and is not represented. -/
def Encap (L : MutexLayout) (st : SC × SyncReg) : Label → Prop
  | .kernel _ (.derive src _ _) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → src ≠ e.guarded
  | .kernel _ (.split src _) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → src ≠ e.guarded
  | .kernel _ (.transfer src _) => TransferExcl L st src
  | .kernel _ (.endUse p) => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → ControlOf L st.1 e ≠ some p ∧
      OptP (slotOf st.1 e.guarded) (fun q => partOf st.1.P p q → p = q) True
  | .spawnVal c _ ls vs => EncapVals L st.2 c (spawnCreate st.1 c ls) vs
  | .deriveSync _ g => ∀ e ∈ st.2, e.Live st.1 → g ≠ e.guarded
  | _ => True

/-- Runs of labelled steps. -/
inductive LRun (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) :
    SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg → List Label → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg → Prop where
  | nil {st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} : LRun k L st [] st
  | cons {st st₁ st₂ : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} {lbl : Label} {lbls : List Label} :
      LStep k L lbl st st₁ → LRun k L st₁ lbls st₂ → LRun k L st (lbl :: lbls) st₂

/-- `EncapsulatedTrace` (WC4 C22, C23: "Any lemma conditional on encapsulation must expose that
condition in its theorem statement or the reachable-trace assumptions"): a run every step of which
satisfies `Encap` in the state where it is taken, read on the kernel state and the
synchronization registry. -/
inductive EncapsulatedTrace (k : K) (L : MutexLayout) :
    SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg → List Label → SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg → Prop where
  | nil {st : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg} : EncapsulatedTrace k L st [] st

import Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.MX
import Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces

/-!
# Corpus of milestone 3: witnesses and corpus theorem

* `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §2 W-C22.3 (b): a transfer whose source is a strict structural subplace of
  `slot`, an `ok` kernel step excluded by `Encap`, after which `SlotInit` fails.
* `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S17a, positive twin as written in the corpus (`endUse(slot)` kills the
  entry, then `endUse(lock)` is admitted by `Encap`).
* `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §3 `CrossContextConflictOnlyShared` and its witness on `MX₄`.

W-C22.2 is `Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.W_C22_2_encap` (block MX).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency.Corpus

open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples Ern.Concurrency
open Ern.Concurrency.Traces (L0)

/-! ## W-C22.3 (b) (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §2) -/

/-- Statics (Spec 1 §47): those of `EncapTraces.sst` (`M = {slot = {a, b}, lock}`, `T` owned by
`slot`, `guarded = root_T`) and `6` the one-leaf place `Z`, `Uninit`. Root authorities: `0` of
`M`, `1` of `T` (held by `slot`), `2` of `Z`. -/
def wst : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), false), ((some 1, none, 0), true),
   ((some 1, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((none, some 1, 0), true),
   ((none, none, 0), false)]

/-- The statics are well formed (Spec 1 §47). -/
theorem wst_ok : StaticsOK wst := by decide

/-- The contract of this witness: `lock` (place 4) is the only `SharedMutable` leaf. -/
abbrev KW : K := KC [4]

/-- Initial state, in `MX₃` once the entry `⟨1, none⟩` is registered. -/
def w0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init wst)
/-- `c0 : transfer(a, Z)` (O4). -/
def w1 : SC := transferEffC w0 0 2 6

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §2 W-C22.3 (b), `ok noyau / hors C22.3 (b)`: after the encapsulated step
`newMutex(guarded)`, `transfer(a, Z)` by context 0, `a` a strict structural subplace of `slot`, is
an `ok` step of Spec 1 §63 re-indexed and `Encap` excludes it; without the exclusion `SlotInit`
(WC4 C21.7) fails after the step. Positive twin: `Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces.traceA`
(`transfer(M, M′)`). -/
theorem W_C22_3b_encap :
    EncapsulatedTrace KW L0 (w0, [], []) [.newMutex 0 1] (w0, [⟨1, none⟩], []) ∧
    opStepC KW (.transfer 2 6) 0 w0 (.ok w1) ∧
    ¬ Encap L0 (w0, [⟨1, none⟩]) (.kernel 0 (.transfer 2 6)) ∧ ¬ SlotInit w1 [⟨1, none⟩] := by
  have hn : NewMutexOk KW L0 [] w0 [] 0 1 (w0, [⟨1, none⟩]) := ⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨.cons trivial (.newMutex hn) .nil, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, fun h => ?_,
    fun h => ?_⟩
  · have := (h ⟨1, none⟩ (List.mem_singleton_self _) (by decide)).1
    revert this; decide
  · have := h ⟨1, none⟩ (List.mem_singleton_self _) (by decide)
    revert this; decide

/-! ## S17a, positive twin of the corpus (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S17a) -/

open Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces in
/-- `c0 : endUse(slot)` from `EncapTraces.e2` (`MX₃`) (O12). -/
def eS : SC := EncapTraces.e2.set (endUseEff (EncapTraces.e2.view 0) 1)
/-- `c0 : endUse(lock)` (O12). -/
def eL : SC := eS.set (endUseEff (eS.view 0) 2)

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S17a, positive twin, `ok`: from `MX₃` (`EncapTraces.e2`, reached by
the encapsulated trace `EncapTraces.traceMutex`), `endUse(slot)` is an `ok` step admitted by
`Encap` that kills the entry (§69 releases `guarded`); then `endUse(lock)` is an `ok` step
admitted by `Encap`, no entry being live. -/
theorem S17a_2_ok : opStepC K0 (.endUse 1) 0 EncapTraces.e2 (.ok eS) ∧
    Encap L0 (EncapTraces.e2, EncapTraces.reg1) (.kernel 0 (.endUse 1)) ∧
    ¬ (⟨4, none⟩ : SyncEntry).Live eS ∧ opStepC K0 (.endUse 2) 0 eS (.ok eL) ∧
    Encap L0 (eS, EncapTraces.reg1) (.kernel 0 (.endUse 2)) := by
  refine ⟨⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, ?_, by decide, ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩,
    fun e he hl => ?_⟩
  · exact (by decide : ∀ e ∈ EncapTraces.reg1, e.Live EncapTraces.e2 →
      ControlOf L0 EncapTraces.e2 e ≠ some 1 ∧
      OptP (slotOf EncapTraces.e2 e.guarded) (fun q => partOf EncapTraces.e2.P 1 q → 1 = q) True)
  · exact absurd hl (by rw [List.mem_singleton.1 he]; decide)

/-! ## The separation of the registries is needed by theorem 4 (Spec 1 §56; WC4 C13.7) -/

/-- An arena registry whose entry administers `T` with `internal = guarded` of the live entry of
`MX₃`: excluded on reached states by the unified guard (`NewArenaPreC.guard`, `lstep_adminSep`). -/
def arBad : ArenaReg := [⟨3, 3, [3], []⟩]
/-- `split(guarded, [T])` by context 0 (O2). -/
def xb1 : SC := x2.set (splitEff (x2.view 0) 3 [[3]])
/-- `store` of the block into `slot′` (place 5) by context 0 (O8). -/
def xb2 : SC := storeEffC xb1 0 x2.A.length 5

/-- Necessity of `AdminSep` for theorem 4 on the arena labels (Spec 1 §56: without the guard,
"simultaneous administration of the same `internal`"): in `MX₃`, which satisfies `KInvCA` and
`SyncState`, with an arena entry whose `internal` is the `guarded` of the live entry, `AdminSep`
fails, `issue` of `T` into `slot′` by context 0 is an `ok` step admitted by `Encap` (which has no
arena clause), and after it `GrantDiscipline` (WC4 C22) fails. -/
theorem adminSep_needed : KInvCA x2 ∧ SyncState L0 x2 regX ∧ ¬ AdminSep x2 regX arBad ∧
    IssueStepC KM x2 arBad 0 0 [3] 5
      (.ok (xb2, arBad.set 0 (Arena.issueMeta x2.flat ⟨3, 3, [3], []⟩ [3]))) ∧
    Encap L0 (x2, regX) (.issue 0 0 [3] 5) ∧ ¬ GrantDiscipline xb2 regX := by
  obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := init_inv (k := KM) (ddKC [2]) mxst_ok L0
  obtain ⟨hk', hs', -⟩ := trace_inv (ddKC [2]) mx3_trace hk hs
  refine ⟨hk', hs', fun h => h ⟨3, none⟩ (by decide) ⟨3, 3, [3], []⟩ (by decide) (by decide)
    (by decide) rfl, .ok (E := ⟨3, 3, [3], []⟩) rfl (by decide) (by decide)
    ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩ ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, trivial, fun h => ?_⟩
  exact (by decide : ¬ NoCoveringDesc xb2 3) (h ⟨3, none⟩ (by decide) (by decide) rfl)

/-! ## `CrossContextConflictOnlyShared` (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §3) -/

/-- `CrossContextConflictOnlyShared` (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §3): for two distinct live contexts, a
`writeShared` of `c` (Spec 1 §68) and a `read3`, `write3` or `writeShared` of `c′` (§66–§68), each
enabled on its own view (WC4 C2), share only `K.SharedMutable` leaves. -/
def CrossContextConflictOnlyShared (k : K) (s : SC) : Prop :=
  ∀ c c', s.Live c → s.Live c' → c ≠ c' → ∀ (a b : Nat) (L L' : List Nat),
    WriteSharedPre k (s.view c) a L →
    (Read3Pre (s.view c') b L' ∨ Write3Pre (s.view c') b L' ∨ WriteSharedPre k (s.view c') b L') →
    ∀ l ∈ L, l ∈ L' → k.SharedMutable l

/-- `CrossContextConflictOnlyShared` holds in every state (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §3; Spec 1 §68.1,
O11.1: every leaf of a `writeShared` region is `K.SharedMutable`). With R4
(`Ern.Concurrency.r4_nonConflict`), the only cross-context conflict that the machine enables, at
the grain of abstract steps, goes through `writeShared` on a `SharedMutable` leaf. This is not a
proof of absence of data races (WC4 OB-C01–OB-C06). -/
theorem crossContextConflictOnlyShared (k : K) (s : SC) : CrossContextConflictOnlyShared k s :=
  fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hw _ l hl _ => hw.shared l hl

/-- Witness of `CrossContextConflictOnlyShared` (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §3; O11.2, O9): in `MX₄`,
`writeShared(lock)` via `root_M` by context 0 and `read3(lock)` via `o1` by context 1 are both
enabled; their regions share exactly `lock`, which is `SharedMutable`. This is the surface of
OB-C03 and OB-C05. -/
theorem crossContextConflictOnlyShared_witness : x4.Live 0 ∧ x4.Live 1 ∧
    WriteSharedPre KM (x4.view 0) 0 [2] ∧ Read3Pre (x4.view 1) 4 [2] ∧ KM.SharedMutable 2 :=
  ⟨by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

end Ern.Concurrency.Corpus

import Ern.Concurrency.Realize

/-!
# Corpus of milestone 3, block MX

`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §0 block MX, §1 S2, S5, S7, S8, S9, S11, S12, S15, §2 W-C22.2.

States of the reference mutex of `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §0, block MX, built by labelled steps from
the initial state of Spec 1 §47, and one theorem per verdict of the cases of §1 on these states
(named `S<case>_<n>_<ok|reject|fail|wait|encap>`, twins in this module). Verdicts are written from
`corpus-spec2-m3.md`; preconditions are checked by `decide`. Verdict encodings (§4 of the corpus):
`ok` and `reject` are outcomes of the step relation; `non habilité` (`wait`) is the absence of an
`ok` outcome of a library operation that defines only `ok` (`∀ st', ¬ Op … st'`); for `unlock` and
`resetLock`, which also define only `ok` (WC4 C17, C18), `reject` is the absence of an `ok`
outcome together with the failing clause named by the corpus.

Contract: `KC [lock]`, the test contract of `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples.K0` except that only
the controller leaves are `K.SharedMutable` (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §0: `K.SharedMutable lock`; §1
S5a: `T` not `SharedMutable`).
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency.Corpus

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples Ern.Concurrency
open Ern.Concurrency.Traces (L0)

/-! ## Contract -/

/-- Test contract of the corpus (Spec 1 §48): no declared disjointness, the leaves of `sm` are
`SharedMutable`, nothing statically pinned, every external use done, every place deallocable,
every deallocation compatible, every allocation satisfiable. -/
def KC (sm : List Nat) : K :=
  ⟨fun _ _ => False, fun l => l ∈ sm, fun _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => True,
    fun _ _ => True, fun _ _ _ => True⟩

instance (sm : List Nat) : ∀ r r', Decidable ((KC sm).DeclaredDisjoint r r') :=
  fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable False)
instance (sm : List Nat) : DecidablePred (KC sm).SharedMutable :=
  fun l => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (l ∈ sm))
instance (sm : List Nat) : DecidablePred (KC sm).Pinned :=
  fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable False)
instance (sm : List Nat) : DecidablePred (KC sm).ExternalDone :=
  fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
instance (sm : List Nat) : DecidablePred (KC sm).Deallocable :=
  fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
instance (sm : List Nat) : ∀ p a, Decidable ((KC sm).FreeCompat p a) :=
  fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
instance (sm : List Nat) : ∀ p ls s, Decidable ((KC sm).Satisfiable p ls s) :=
  fun _ _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)

/-- `DDSound` of the corpus contract (Spec 1 §80): nothing is declared disjoint. -/
theorem ddKC (sm : List Nat) : DDSound (KC sm) := fun _ _ h => h.elim

/-! ## Block MX (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §0) -/

/-- Statics (Spec 1 §47): `0` the mutex value `M`, `1` its field `slot` (`Uninit`), `2` its field
`lock` (`Init`), `3` the protected root `T` (`Init`), owned by `M`; `4` the mutex-shaped value `M′`
with fields `5` (`slot′`) and `6` (`lock′`), `Uninit`. Root authorities: `0` of `M` (frame 0), `1`
of `T` (held by `M`), `2` of `M′` (frame 0). -/
def mxst : Statics :=
/-- The steps of block MX (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §0): each is an `ok` step; `ControlOf(e)` is
`lock`. -/
theorem mx_steps : opStepC KM (.derive 1 [3] .modify) 0 x0 (.ok x1) ∧
    opStepC KM (.store 3 1) 0 x1 (.ok x2) ∧ NewMutexOk KM L0 [] x2 [] 0 3 (x2, regX) ∧
    ControlOf L0 x2 ⟨3, none⟩ = some 2 ∧
    opStepC KM (.derive 0 [1, 2] .observe) 0 x2 (.ok x3) ∧ SpawnStep x3 0 [4] [] (.ok x4) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, ⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩,
    by decide, ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩⟩

/-- `MX₃` (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §0) is reached from the initial state by an `EncapsulatedTrace`
(WC4 C22, C23). -/
theorem mx3_trace : EncapsulatedTrace KM L0 (x0, [], [])
    [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 3 1), .newMutex 0 3] (x2, regX, []) :=
  .cons (fun e he => by cases he) (.kernel mx_steps.1) <|
  .cons trivial (.kernel mx_steps.2.1) <| .cons trivial (.newMutex mx_steps.2.2.1) .nil

/-- `MX₄` (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §0) is reached from the initial state by an `EncapsulatedTrace`
(WC4 C22, C23). -/
theorem mx4_trace : EncapsulatedTrace KM L0 (x0, [], [])
    [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 3 1), .newMutex 0 3,
     .kernel 0 (.derive 0 [1, 2] .observe), .spawn 0 [4] []] (x4, regX, []) :=
  .cons (fun e he => by cases he) (.kernel mx_steps.1) <|
  .cons trivial (.kernel mx_steps.2.1) <| .cons trivial (.newMutex mx_steps.2.2.1) <|
  .cons (by decide : ∀ e ∈ regX, e.Live x2 → 0 ≠ e.guarded) (.kernel mx_steps.2.2.2.2.1) <|
  .cons trivial (.spawn mx_steps.2.2.2.2.2) .nil

/-- In `MX₄`, `root_M` has effective mode `Observe` on `slot` and `lock` (Spec 1 §43.4) and
`CtrlRight` holds for frame 0 and for the initial frame 1 of context 1 (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §0,
step 4). -/
theorem mx4_facts : effective x4.flat 0 1 = some .observe ∧ effective x4.flat 0 2 = some .observe ∧
    CtrlRight L0 x4 ⟨3, none⟩ 0 ∧ CtrlRight L0 x4 ⟨3, none⟩ 1 := by decide

/-! ## S2 (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S2) -/

/-- `c1 : acquire(e)`: grant `g`, authority 5, held by frame 1 (WC4 C16). -/
def x7 : SC := x6.set (releaseEff (x6.view 1) 5)

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S2, step 1, `ok` (WC4 C16): from `MX₄`, `acquire(e)` by context 1. -/
theorem S2_1_ok : AcquireOk KM L0 x4 regX 1 0 (x5, regG) :=
  ⟨by decide, ⟨3, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S2, step 2, `ok` (O10): `write3(T)` via `g` by context 1, whose current
frame holds `g` with effective mode `Modify`. -/
theorem S2_2_ok : opStepC KM (.write 5 [3]) 1 x5 (.ok x6) := ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S2, step 3, `ok` (WC4 C17): `unlock(e)` by context 1. -/
theorem S2_3_ok : UnlockOk L0 x6 regG 1 0 (x7, regX) :=
  ⟨by decide, ⟨3, some 5⟩, 5, rfl, by decide, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S2, negative twin, `non habilité` (WC4 C14.2: `grant ≠ none`): while
`g` is active, `acquire(e)` by context 0 has no `ok` outcome. The other negative twin, two active
grants on `footprint(T)`, is excluded by `grants_exclusive` (T6). -/
theorem S2_4_wait : ∀ st', ¬ AcquireOk KM L0 x5 regG 0 0 st' := by
  rintro st' ⟨-, e, he, ⟨-, hg, -⟩, -⟩
  cases he; cases hg

/-- The steps of S2 continue the encapsulated trace of `MX₄` (WC4 C22, C23). -/
theorem s2_trace : EncapsulatedTrace KM L0 (x0, [], [])
    [.kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 3 1), .newMutex 0 3,
     .kernel 0 (.derive 0 [1, 2] .observe), .spawn 0 [4] [], .acquire 1 0,
     .kernel 1 (.write 5 [3]), .unlock 1 0] (x7, regX, []) := by
  have h := mx4_trace.snoc (lbl := .acquire 1 0) (st' := (x5, regG, [])) trivial (.acquire S2_1_ok)
  have h := h.snoc (lbl := .kernel 1 (.write 5 [3])) (st' := (x6, regG, [])) trivial
    (.kernel S2_2_ok)
  exact h.snoc (lbl := .unlock 1 0) (st' := (x7, regX, [])) trivial (.unlock S2_3_ok)

/-! ## S5 (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S5a, S5b) -/

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S5a, `reject` (O11.1: `T` is not `SharedMutable`): from `MX₄` with
`g` held by context 1, `writeShared(T)` via `g`. Positive twin: `S2_2_ok`. -/
theorem S5a_1_reject : opStepC KM (.writeShared 5 [3]) 1 x5 .reject :=
  ⟨by decide, _, .reject (by decide), rfl⟩

/-- `c1 : writeShared(lock)` via `o1` (O11). -/
def x4w : SC := x4.set (write3Eff (x4.view 1) [2])

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S5b, `ok noyau` (O11.1, O11.2), outside C22.4 and classed under OB-C05:
from `MX₄`, `writeShared(lock)` via `o1` by context 1 outside `acquire`/`unlock` is an `ok` kernel
step and `Encap` admits it (WC4 C22.4, the controller-write protocol, is a realization/interface
obligation not represented in `S_C`). Positive twin: `S2_1_ok`, `S2_3_ok`. -/
theorem S5b_1_ok : opStepC KM (.writeShared 4 [2]) 1 x4 (.ok x4w) ∧
    Encap L0 (x4, regX) (.kernel 1 (.writeShared 4 [2])) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, trivial⟩

/-! ## S7, negative twin (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S7) -/

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S7, negative twin, `reject` (Spec 1 §63.1: frame 0 no longer has
effective `Modify` over `M`; §63.4): from `MX₄`, `transfer(M, M′)` by context 0. The positive
case is `Ern.Concurrency.EncapTraces.traceA`, `traceB`. -/
theorem S7_2_reject : opStepC KM (.transfer 0 4) 0 x4 .reject ∧
    ¬ HasRight (x4.view 0) .modify 0 ∧
    ¬ ∃ g ∈ List.range (x4.view 0).A.length, Grounds (x4.view 0) .modify 0 g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range (x4.view 0).A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside (x4.view 0) 0 j →
        RightChain (x4.view 0) g j :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, .reject (by decide)⟩, by decide, by decide⟩

/-! ## S8 (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S8) -/

/-- `c1 : enterFrame f2` without yielding `g` (O6): frame 2. -/
def x8 : SC := enterEffC x5 1 [] []

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S8, `reject` (Spec 1 §43: `g` is held by the initial frame 1 of
context 1, neither the current frame nor a place): after `enterFrame f2`, `write3(T)` via `g`. -/
theorem S8_1_reject : opStepC KM (.enter [] []) 1 x5 (.ok x8) ∧
    opStepC KM (.write 5 [3]) 1 x8 .reject :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, ⟨by decide, _, .reject (by decide), rfl⟩⟩

/-- `c1 : g′ := derive(g, Modify)`, authority 6 (O1). -/
def x9 : SC := x5.set (deriveEff (x5.view 1) 5 [3] .modify)
/-- `c1 : enterFrame f2` yielding `g′` (O6): frame 2. -/
def x10 : SC := enterEffC x9 1 [6] []
/-- `f2 : write3(T)` via `g′` (O10). -/
def x11 : SC := x10.set (write3Eff (x10.view 1) [3])

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S8, positive twin, `ok`: `enterFrame f2` yielding `g′ := derive(g,
Modify)`, then `write3(T)` via `g′`. -/
theorem S8_2_ok : opStepC KM (.derive 5 [3] .modify) 1 x5 (.ok x9) ∧
    opStepC KM (.enter [6] []) 1 x9 (.ok x10) ∧ opStepC KM (.write 6 [3]) 1 x10 (.ok x11) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩,
    ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩⟩

/-! ## S15 (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S15) -/

/-- `c1 : enterFrame f2` yielding the whole grant `g` (O6): frame 2. -/
def z1 : SC := enterEffC x5 1 [5] []
/-- `f2 : write3(T)` via `g` (O10). -/
def z2 : SC := z1.set (write3Eff (z1.view 1) [3])
/-- `exitFrameC(f2)` (O7, WC4 C6): `g` is released. -/
def z3 : SC := exitEffC z2 1

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S15, steps 1–3, `ok`, `ok`, `ok` (O6, O10, O7: `exitFrameC` releases
`g`, which is not returned, Spec 1 §45). -/
theorem S15_1_ok : opStepC KM (.enter [5] []) 1 x5 (.ok z1) ∧
    opStepC KM (.write 5 [3]) 1 z1 (.ok z2) ∧ opStepC KM .exit 1 z2 (.ok z3) ∧
    ¬ z3.flat.Active 5 :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩,
    by decide⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S15, step 4, `reject` (WC4 C17.2: `g` is inactive): `unlock(e)` by
context 1 has no `ok` outcome, the recorded grant being inactive (the leaked-lock state of
S11). -/
theorem S15_4_reject : (∀ st', ¬ UnlockOk L0 z3 regG 1 0 st') ∧ ¬ z3.flat.Active 5 := by
  refine ⟨?_, by decide⟩
  rintro st' ⟨-, e, g, he, -, hg, hrel, -⟩
  cases he; cases hg
  exact (by decide : ¬ ReleasePre (z3.view 1) 5) hrel

/-- `exitFrameC(f2)` after `write3(T)` via `g′` (O7): `g′` is released. -/
def x12 : SC := exitEffC x11 1
/-- `c1 : unlock(e)` (WC4 C17). -/
def x13 : SC := x12.set (releaseEff (x12.view 1) 5)

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S15, positive twin, `ok`: after `write3(T)` via `g′` (`S8_2_ok`),
`exitFrameC(f2)` releases `g′`, and `unlock(e)` succeeds (`g` active, without descendant). -/
theorem S15_5_ok : opStepC KM .exit 1 x11 (.ok x12) ∧ ¬ x12.flat.Active 6 ∧
    UnlockOk L0 x12 regG 1 0 (x13, regX) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, by decide,
    ⟨by decide, ⟨3, some 5⟩, 5, rfl, by decide, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩⟩

/-! ## S11 (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S11) -/

/-- `c1 : enterFrame f1′` without parameter (O6): frame 2. -/
def y0 : SC := enterEffC x4 1 [] []

/-- The setup of `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S11 read literally: after `enterFrame f1′` without
parameter, frame 2 holds no authority over `lock`, so WC4 C14.3 (`CtrlRight`) fails and
`acquire(e)` by context 1 has no `ok` outcome. The cases below pass `o1′ := derive(o1, Observe)`
to `f1′` (`y1`, `y1'`). -/
theorem S11_setup_wait : opStepC KM (.enter [] []) 1 x4 (.ok y0) ∧ ¬ CtrlRight L0 y0 ⟨3, none⟩ 2 ∧
    ∀ st', ¬ AcquireOk KM L0 y0 regX 1 0 st' := by
  refine ⟨⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, by decide, ?_⟩
  rintro st' ⟨-, e, he, hauth, -⟩
  cases he; exact (by decide : ¬ EntryAuth L0 y0 ⟨3, none⟩ (y0.view 1).top) hauth

/-- `c1 : o1′ := derive(o1, Observe, {slot, lock})`, authority 5 (O1). -/
def y1 : SC := x4.set (deriveEff (x4.view 1) 4 [1, 2] .observe)
/-- `c1 : enterFrame f1′` yielding `o1′` (O6): frame 2. -/
def y1' : SC := enterEffC y1 1 [5] []
/-- `c1 : acquire(e)`: `g`, authority 6, held by frame 2 (WC4 C16). -/
def y2 : SC := deriveSyncEff y1' 1 3
/-- The registry with the grant `g` = 6 recorded (WC4 C16). -/
def regG6 : SyncReg := [⟨3, some 6⟩]
/-- `c1 : exitFrameC(f1′)` without `unlock` (O7). -/
def y3 : SC := exitEffC y2 1

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S11, step 1, `ok` (O7 releases `g`): from `MX₄`, after
`enterFrame f1′` yielding `o1′` and `acquire(e)` by context 1, `exitFrameC(f1′)` without `unlock`;
`g` is inactive and the registry still records it. -/
theorem S11_1_ok : opStepC KM (.derive 4 [1, 2] .observe) 1 x4 (.ok y1) ∧
    opStepC KM (.enter [5] []) 1 y1 (.ok y1') ∧ AcquireOk KM L0 y1' regX 1 0 (y2, regG6) ∧
    opStepC KM .exit 1 y2 (.ok y3) ∧ ¬ y3.flat.Active 6 :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩,
    ⟨by decide, ⟨3, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩,
    by decide⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S11, step 2, `non habilité` (WC4 C14.2: `grant = some g`, `g`
inactive): `acquire(e)` by context 0. -/
theorem S11_2_wait : ∀ st', ¬ AcquireOk KM L0 y3 regG6 0 0 st' := by
  rintro st' ⟨-, e, he, ⟨-, hg, -⟩, -⟩
  cases he; cases hg

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S11, step 3, `reject` (WC4 C18.1: `ExercisableAt(guarded, Modify)`
needs `Modify` over `M`, and `root_M` has only `Observe` effective while `o1` is active):
`resetLock(e)` by context 0 has no `ok` outcome. -/
theorem S11_3_reject : (∀ st', ¬ ResetLockOk L0 y3 regG6 0 0 st') ∧
    ¬ (y3.view 0).ExercisableAt 3 .modify := by
  refine ⟨?_, by decide⟩
  rintro st' ⟨-, e, he, hex, -⟩
  cases he
  exact (by decide : ¬ (y3.view 0).ExercisableAt 3 .modify) hex

/-- `c1 : terminate` (WC4 C7). -/
def y4 : SC := termEffC y3 1
/-- `c0 : acquire(e)` after `resetLock(e)`: grant authority 7, held by frame 0 (WC4 C16). -/
def y5 : SC := deriveSyncEff y4 0 3

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S11, positive twin, `ok`: `c1 : terminate`; `c0 : join(c1)`;
`resetLock(e)` (`root_M` has effective `Modify` again); `acquire(e)`. -/
theorem S11_4_ok : TermStep KM y3 1 (.ok y4) ∧ JoinStep y4 0 1 (.ok y4) ∧
    ResetLockOk L0 y4 regG6 0 0 (y4, regX) ∧ AcquireOk KM L0 y4 regX 0 0 (y5, [⟨3, some 7⟩]) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, .ok (by decide) (by decide),
    ⟨by decide, ⟨3, some 6⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩,
    ⟨by decide, ⟨3, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩⟩

/-! ## S12 (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S12) -/

/-- `c0 : write3(lock)` via `root_M` (O10). -/
def x2w : SC := x2.set (write3Eff (x2.view 0) [2])

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S12, `ok noyau` (O10), outside C22.4 and classed under OB-C05: from
`MX₃`, `write3(lock)` via `root_M` by context 0 is an `ok` kernel step and `Encap` admits it (WC4
C22.4 is a realization/interface obligation not represented in `S_C`). -/
theorem S12_1_ok : opStepC KM (.write 0 [2]) 0 x2 (.ok x2w) ∧
    Encap L0 (x2, regX) (.kernel 0 (.write 0 [2])) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, trivial⟩

/-- `c0 : acquire(e)` in `MX₃`: grant authority 4, held by frame 0 (WC4 C16). -/
def x2a : SC := deriveSyncEff x2 0 3
/-- `c0 : unlock(e)` (WC4 C17). -/
def x2u : SC := x2a.set (releaseEff (x2a.view 0) 4)

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S12, twin, `ok`: in `MX₃`, `acquire(e)` then `unlock(e)` by context 0,
the operations of the protocol. -/
theorem S12_2_ok : AcquireOk KM L0 x2 regX 0 0 (x2a, [⟨3, some 4⟩]) ∧
    UnlockOk L0 x2a [⟨3, some 4⟩] 0 0 (x2u, regX) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, ⟨3, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩,
    ⟨by decide, ⟨3, some 4⟩, 4, rfl, by decide, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩⟩

/-! ## W-C22.2 (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §2) -/

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §2 W-C22.2, `ok noyau / hors C22.2`: from `MX₄`, context 1 outside
`acquire` takes the raw `deriveSync(guarded)` step under the library instantiation (the facts
C14.1–C14.3 hold); `Encap` excludes it (WC4 C22.2). After the step the registry still records
`grant = none` while an active descendant covers `T`: `GrantDiscipline` fails, and `acquire(e)` is
enabled for neither context (WC4 C13.9, C14: blocking descendant). Positive twin: `S2_1_ok`. -/
theorem W_C22_2_encap : DeriveSyncStep (libKC KM L0) regX x4 1 3 (.ok x5) ∧
    ¬ Encap L0 (x4, regX) (.deriveSync 1 3) ∧ ¬ GrantDiscipline x5 regX ∧
    ∀ st', ¬ AcquireOk KM L0 x5 regX 0 0 st' ∧ ¬ AcquireOk KM L0 x5 regX 1 0 st' := by
  refine ⟨⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, fun h => h ⟨3, none⟩ (by decide) (by decide) rfl,
    fun h => (by decide : ¬ NoCoveringDesc x5 3) (h ⟨3, none⟩ (by decide) (by decide) rfl),
    fun st' => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨-, e, he, -, hpre, -⟩
    cases he; exact (by decide : ¬ DeriveSyncPre (libKC KM L0) regX x5 0 3) hpre
  · rintro ⟨-, e, he, -, hpre, -⟩
    cases he; exact (by decide : ¬ DeriveSyncPre (libKC KM L0) regX x5 1 3) hpre

/-- Statics (Spec 1 §47): two mutex values of the same type, each as in block MX: `0` `M1` with
fields `1` (`slot1`, `Uninit`) and `2` (`lock1`, `Init`), `3` `T1` (`Init`) owned by `M1`; `4`
`M2` with fields `5` (`slot2`) and `6` (`lock2`), `7` `T2` owned by `M2`. Root authorities: `0`

import Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.MX

/-!
# Corpus of milestone 3, block AR

`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §0 block AR and §1 S3: an arena whose arena value is administered through a
mutex grant (WC4 C19; Spec 1 §36, §46, §76–§78), shared between contexts 0 and 1. One theorem per
verdict, written from `corpus-spec2-m3.md`; preconditions checked by `decide`.

The arena operations are those of `LStep` (`NewArenaStepC`, `IssueStepC`, `ResetStepC`): the
derived operations of `Ern.MemoryModel.Arena` executed by the context, `store` reading
`ancestorC` (WC4 C2, C3). `S3_8_view_literal` records that `Arena.IssueD` run on the view of the
executing context, which reads the stack order of the view instead of `ancestorC`, rejects step 8.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency.Corpus

open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency
open Ern.Concurrency.Traces (L0)

/-- Statics (Spec 1 §47): `0` the mutex value `M2` with fields `1` (`slot2`, `Uninit`) and `2`
(`lock2`, `Init`); `3` the arena value `AV`, a root leaf owned by `M2`, `Init`; `4` the storage
`ST`, a root owned by frame 0 with the leaves `5` (`R1`) and `6` (`R2`); `7` the leaf `d0`, a root
owned by frame 0. Root authorities: `0` of `M2`, `1` of `AV` (held by `M2`), `2` of `ST`, `3` of `d0`. -/
def arst : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
   ((none, some 0, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false), ((some 4, none, 0), false),
   ((some 4, none, 0), false), ((none, none, 0), false)]

/-- The statics are well formed (Spec 1 §47). -/
theorem arst_ok : StaticsOK arst := by decide

/-- The contract of block AR: `lock2` (place 2) is the only `SharedMutable` leaf. -/
abbrev KA : K := KC [2]

/-- Initial state of block AR. -/
def a0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init arst)
/-- AR step 1: `internal := derive(root_ST, Modify, footprint(ST))`, authority 4. -/
def a1 : SC := a0.set (deriveEff (a0.view 0) 2 [5, 6] .modify)
/-- AR step 1: `store(internal, AV)`. -/
def a2 : SC := storeEffC a1 0 4 3
/-- AR step 1: the arena registry after `newArena(ST, internal)` (O17): the arena value is `AV`. -/
def arA : ArenaReg := [⟨4, 4, [5, 6], []⟩]
/-- AR step 2: `guarded2 := derive(root_AV, Modify, {AV})`, authority 5. -/
def a3 : SC := a2.set (deriveEff (a2.view 0) 1 [3] .modify)
/-- AR step 2: `store(guarded2, slot2)`. -/
def a4 : SC := storeEffC a3 0 5 1
/-- AR step 2: the synchronization registry after `newMutex(guarded2)`, entry `e2` (WC4 C13). -/
def regA : SyncReg := [⟨5, none⟩]
/-- AR step 3: `o1 := derive(root_M2, Observe, {slot2, lock2})`, authority 6. -/
def a5 : SC := a4.set (deriveEff (a4.view 0) 0 [1, 2] .observe)
/-- AR step 3: `spawn c1` yielding `o1`, with the local leaf `d1` (place 8, root authority 7):
context 1, initial frame 1. -/
def a6 : SC := spawnEff a5 0 [6] [(none, 0)]

/-- The construction of block AR (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §0): an `EncapsulatedTrace` from the
initial state (WC4 C22, C23); `ControlOf(e2) = lock2`, the arena value is `AV`, and
`{AV} ∩ {slot2, lock2} = ∅` (WC4 C13.4). -/
theorem ar_trace : EncapsulatedTrace KA L0 (a0, [], [])
    [.kernel 0 (.derive 2 [5, 6] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 3), .newArena 0 4 4,
     .kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 5 1), .newMutex 0 5,
     .kernel 0 (.derive 0 [1, 2] .observe), .spawn 0 [6] [(none, 0)]] (a6, regA, arA) ∧
    ControlOf L0 a4 ⟨5, none⟩ = some 2 ∧ Arena.arenaValue a2.flat ⟨4, 4, [5, 6], []⟩ = some 3 := by
  refine ⟨?_, by decide, by decide⟩
  have hn : NewMutexOk KA L0 arA a4 [] 0 5 (a4, regA) := ⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩
  have ha : NewArenaStepC a2 [] [] 0 4 4 (.ok (a2, arA)) := ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩
  exact .cons (fun e he => by cases he) (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
    .cons trivial (.kernel ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) <|
    .cons trivial (.newArena ha) <|
    .cons (fun e he => by cases he) (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
    .cons trivial (.kernel ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) <|
    .cons trivial (.newMutex hn) <|
    .cons (by decide : ∀ e ∈ regA, e.Live a4 → 0 ≠ e.guarded)
      (.kernel ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩) <|
    .cons trivial (.spawn ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩) .nil

/-! ## S3 (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S3) -/

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S3, step 1, `reject` (Spec 1 §77.1, `MetaRight`: context 1 has no
exercisable `Modify` over `AV`, only `Observe` over `M2`): `issue(arena, R1, d1)` by context 1
without grant, rejected by a static check. -/
theorem S3_1_reject : IssueStepC KA a6 arA 1 0 [5] 8 .reject ∧
    ¬ Arena.MetaRight (a6.view 1) ⟨4, 4, [5, 6], []⟩ :=
  ⟨.static (by decide) rfl (by decide), by decide⟩

/-- `c1 : acquire(e2)`: `g2`, authority 8, held by frame 1 (WC4 C16). -/
def a7 : SC := deriveSyncEff a6 1 5
/-- The registry with `g2` recorded. -/
def regA8 : SyncReg := [⟨5, some 8⟩]

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S3, step 2, `ok` (WC4 C16): `acquire(e2)` by context 1. -/
theorem S3_2_ok : AcquireOk KA L0 a6 regA 1 0 (a7, regA8) :=
  ⟨by decide, ⟨5, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩

/-- `split(internal, [R1])` by context 1: the block, authority 9, held by frame 1 (O2). -/
def a8s : SC := a7.set (splitEff (a7.view 1) 4 [[5]])
/-- `store(block, d1)` by context 1 (O8). -/
def a8 : SC := storeEffC a8s 1 a7.A.length 8
/-- The arena registry after the issue of `R1` (Spec 1 §77 effect). -/
def arA1 : ArenaReg := arA.set 0 (Arena.issueMeta a7.flat ⟨4, 4, [5, 6], []⟩ [5])

/-- The block of `R1` is authority 9; `R2` is still available (Spec 1 §77 effect). -/
theorem arA1_eq : a7.A.length = 9 ∧ arA1 = [⟨4, 4, [6], [([5], 9)]⟩] := by decide

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S3, step 3, `ok` (Spec 1 §43 clause 2: `g2` gives `Modify` over `{AV}`,
so `ExercisableAt(internal, Modify)`; §77.3, §77.6: `d1` is a local leaf of context 1 and the
effective anchor `root_ST` is in frame 0, an ancestor): `issue(arena, R1, d1)` by context 1. -/
theorem S3_3_ok : IssueStepC KA a7 arA 1 0 [5] 8 (.ok (a8, arA1)) :=
  .ok (E := ⟨4, 4, [5, 6], []⟩) rfl (by decide) (by decide) ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩
    ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S3, step 4, `non habilité` (WC4 C14.2): `acquire(e2)` by context 0
while `g2` is recorded. -/
theorem S3_4_wait : ∀ st', ¬ AcquireOk KA L0 a8 regA8 0 0 st' := by
  rintro st' ⟨-, e, he, ⟨-, hg, -⟩, -⟩
  cases he; cases hg

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S3, extra negative, `reject` (Spec 1 §78.2: an active block derived
from `internal` covers `R1`): `reset(arena)` by context 1 under `g2`. In the derived operation the
`derive` of `internal` over the storage is rejected (§60.2: the effective mode of `internal` on
`R1` is absent, §43.3). -/
theorem S3_3b_reject : ResetStepC a8 arA1 1 0 .reject ∧
    ¬ DerivePre (a8.view 1) 4 [5, 6] .modify :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, _, .derive rfl (.reject (by decide)), rfl⟩, by decide⟩

/-- `c1 : unlock(e2)` (WC4 C17). -/
def a9 : SC := a8.set (releaseEff (a8.view 1) 8)

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S3, step 5, `ok` (WC4 C17): `unlock(e2)` by context 1. -/
theorem S3_5_ok : UnlockOk L0 a8 regA8 1 0 (a9, regA) :=
  ⟨by decide, ⟨5, some 8⟩, 8, rfl, by decide, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩

/-- `c0 : acquire(e2)`: `g2′`, authority 10, held by frame 0 (WC4 C16). -/
def a10 : SC := deriveSyncEff a9 0 5
/-- The registry with `g2′` recorded. -/
def regA10 : SyncReg := [⟨5, some 10⟩]

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S3, step 6, `ok` (WC4 C16): `acquire(e2)` by context 0. -/
theorem S3_6_ok : AcquireOk KA L0 a9 regA 0 0 (a10, regA10) :=
  ⟨by decide, ⟨5, none⟩, rfl, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S3, step 7, **`fail`** (Spec 1 §77.4: `R1` is unavailable; the state is
unchanged, no block is duplicated): `issue(arena, R1, d0)` by context 0, the static checks
holding. -/
theorem S3_7_fail : IssueStepC KA a10 arA1 0 0 [5] 7 .fail ∧
    Arena.IssueStatic (a10.view 0) ⟨4, 4, [6], [([5], 9)]⟩ [5] 7 ∧
    ∀ st', ¬ IssueStepC KA a10 arA1 0 0 [5] 7 (.ok st') := by
  have hE : arA1[0]? = some ⟨4, 4, [6], [([5], 9)]⟩ := by decide
  refine ⟨.fail (by decide) hE (by decide) (by decide), by decide, fun st' h => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨E, s₁, hE', -, hav, -⟩ := issueStepC_ok h
  rw [hE] at hE'; cases hE'
  exact (by decide : ¬ Arena.Avail ⟨4, 4, [6], [([5], 9)]⟩ [5]) hav

/-- `split(internal, [R2])` by context 0: the block, authority 11, held by frame 0 (O2). -/
def a11s : SC := a10.set (splitEff (a10.view 0) 4 [[6]])
/-- `store(block, d0)` by context 0 (O8). -/
def a11 : SC := storeEffC a11s 0 a10.A.length 7
/-- The arena registry after the issue of `R2`. -/
def arA2 : ArenaReg := arA1.set 0 (Arena.issueMeta a10.flat ⟨4, 4, [6], [([5], 9)]⟩ [6])

/-- The block of `R2` is authority 11; nothing is available any more (Spec 1 §77 effect). -/
theorem arA2_eq : a10.A.length = 11 ∧ arA2 = [⟨4, 4, [], [([6], 11), ([5], 9)]⟩] := by decide

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S3, step 8, `ok`: `issue(arena, R2, d0)` by context 0, while the block
of `R1`, anchored in frame 0, is held by `d1`, a local of context 1. -/
theorem S3_8_ok : IssueStepC KA a10 arA1 0 0 [6] 7 (.ok (a11, arA2)) :=
  .ok (E := ⟨4, 4, [6], [([5], 9)]⟩) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩ ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- Step 8 with `Arena.IssueD` run on the view of context 0 (Spec 1 §77 with the sequential
`ancestor` of §39 on the stack of the view): the `store` of the block is rejected, because
`AnchorOrderHeld` (§65.5) reads the order of the view's stack, in which frame 0 is not an
ancestor of frame 1 holding `d1`; with `ancestorC` (WC4 C3) step 8 is `ok` (`S3_8_ok`). -/
theorem S3_8_view_literal : Arena.IssueD KA 0 [6] 7 ⟨a10.view 0, arA1⟩ .reject ∧
    ¬ AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff (splitEff (a10.view 0) 4 [[6]]) (a10.view 0).A.length 7) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeldC (storeEffC a11s 0 a10.A.length 7) :=
  ⟨.store (E := ⟨4, 4, [6], [([5], 9)]⟩) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide))
    (.reject (by decide)), by decide, by decide⟩

/-- The construction of S3 continues the encapsulated trace of block AR (WC4 C22, C23). -/
theorem s3_trace : EncapsulatedTrace KA L0 (a0, [], [])
    [.kernel 0 (.derive 2 [5, 6] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 4 3), .newArena 0 4 4,
     .kernel 0 (.derive 1 [3] .modify), .kernel 0 (.store 5 1), .newMutex 0 5,
     .kernel 0 (.derive 0 [1, 2] .observe), .spawn 0 [6] [(none, 0)], .acquire 1 0,
     .issue 1 0 [5] 8, .unlock 1 0, .acquire 0 0, .issue 0 0 [6] 7] (a11, regA10, arA2) := by
  have h := ar_trace.1.snoc (lbl := .acquire 1 0) (st' := (a7, regA8, arA)) trivial
    (.acquire S3_2_ok)
  have h := h.snoc (lbl := .issue 1 0 [5] 8) (st' := (a8, regA8, arA1)) trivial (.issue S3_3_ok)
  have h := h.snoc (lbl := .unlock 1 0) (st' := (a9, regA, arA1)) trivial (.unlock S3_5_ok)
  have h := h.snoc (lbl := .acquire 0 0) (st' := (a10, regA10, arA1)) trivial (.acquire S3_6_ok)
  exact h.snoc (lbl := .issue 0 0 [6] 7) (st' := (a11, regA10, arA2)) trivial (.issue S3_8_ok)

import Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.MX

/-!
# Corpus of milestone 3, frames and contexts

`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S1a, S1b, S4 (negative twin), S13, S14: frame exit, reparenting,
by-value spawn, conflicting and compatible accesses across contexts (WC4 C4–C8; Spec 1 §43, §50,
§60–§62, §66, §67, §72, §73). One theorem per verdict, written from `corpus-spec2-m3.md`;
preconditions checked by `decide`. The positive case of S4 is
`Ern.Concurrency.Traces.s4_trace`, `s4_detached_child` and
`Ern.Concurrency.RealizeWitness.s4_realized`.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency.Corpus

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples Ern.Concurrency

/-- The contract of this module: no `SharedMutable` leaf. -/
abbrev KF : K := KC []

/-! ## S1a (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S1a) -/

/-- No static (Spec 1 §47). -/
def nost : Statics := []

/-- Initial state: the base frame 0 alone. -/
def p0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init nost)
/-- `c0 : enterFrame f1` with the local `X` (place 0, root authority 0): frame 1 (O6). -/
def p1 : SC := enterEffC p0 0 [] [(none, 0)]
/-- `X` becomes `Init` (O10 via `root_X`). -/
def p2 : SC := p1.set (write3Eff (p1.view 0) [0])
/-- `a := derive(root_X, Modify)`, authority 1, held by frame 1 (O1). -/
def p3 : SC := p2.set (deriveEff (p2.view 0) 0 [0] .modify)
/-- `spawn c1` yielding `a` (WC4 C4): context 1, initial frame 2, parent frame 1. -/
def p4 : SC := spawnEff p3 0 [1] []

/-- The setup of S1a: `enterFrame f1` with `X`, `write3(X)`, `derive`, `spawn c1` yielding `a`. -/
theorem s1a_setup : opStepC KF (.enter [] [(none, 0)]) 0 p0 (.ok p1) ∧
    opStepC KF (.write 0 [0]) 0 p1 (.ok p2) ∧ opStepC KF (.derive 0 [0] .modify) 0 p2 (.ok p3) ∧
    SpawnStep p3 0 [1] [] (.ok p4) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩,
    ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S1a, `reject` (O7.2: an active authority is attached to a dying local;
WC4 C6): `exitFrameC(f1)` by context 0 while context 1 holds `a`; the surviving `a` has no
surviving origin (§73.4). -/
theorem S1a_1_reject : opStepC KF .exit 0 p4 .reject ∧
    firstSurv (p4.view 0) (p4.view 0).F.tail ((p4.view 0).ancs 1) = none :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, .reject (by decide)⟩, by decide⟩

/-- `c1 : release(a)` (O3). -/
def p5 : SC := p4.set (releaseEff (p4.view 1) 1)
/-- `c1 : terminate` (WC4 C7). -/
def p6 : SC := termEffC p5 1
/-- `c0 : exitFrameC(f1)` (O7, WC4 C6). -/
def p7 : SC := exitEffC p6 0

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S1a, positive twin, `ok`: `c1 : release(a)` (O3); `c1 : terminate`;
`c0 : join(c1)` (WC4 C8); `c0 : exitFrameC(f1)`. -/
theorem S1a_2_ok : opStepC KF (.release 1) 1 p4 (.ok p5) ∧ TermStep KF p5 1 (.ok p6) ∧
    JoinStep p6 0 1 (.ok p6) ∧ opStepC KF .exit 0 p6 (.ok p7) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩,
    .ok (by decide) (by decide), ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩⟩

/-! ## S1b (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S1b) -/

/-- Statics (Spec 1 §47): `0` the local `Y` of the base frame, `Init`; root authority `0`. -/
def yst : Statics := [((none, none, 0), true)]

/-- Initial state of S1b. -/
def b0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init yst)
/-- `q := derive(root_Y, Modify)`, authority 1 (O1). -/
def b1 : SC := b0.set (deriveEff (b0.view 0) 0 [0] .modify)
/-- `enterFrame f1` yielding `q` (O6): frame 1. -/
def b2 : SC := enterEffC b1 0 [1] []
/-- In `f1`: `a := derive(q, Modify)`, authority 2 (O1). -/
def b3 : SC := b2.set (deriveEff (b2.view 0) 1 [0] .modify)
/-- `spawn c1` yielding `a` (WC4 C4): context 1, initial frame 2, parent frame 1. -/
def b4 : SC := spawnEff b3 0 [2] []
/-- `c0 : exitFrameC(f1)` (O7, WC4 C6). -/
def b5 : SC := exitEffC b4 0

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S1b, `ok` (O7.4: `q` is released, `a` survives and is reanchored on
`root_Y`; O7.5: the effective anchor is in frame 0, ancestor of the initial frame of context 1
after its reparenting on frame 0, WC4 C6.3): `exitFrameC(f1)` by context 0. -/
theorem S1b_1_ok : opStepC KF (.derive 0 [0] .modify) 0 b0 (.ok b1) ∧
    opStepC KF (.enter [1] []) 0 b1 (.ok b2) ∧ opStepC KF (.derive 1 [0] .modify) 0 b2 (.ok b3) ∧
    SpawnStep b3 0 [2] [] (.ok b4) ∧ opStepC KF .exit 0 b4 (.ok b5) ∧
    ¬ b5.flat.Active 1 ∧ b5.flat.org 2 = some 0 ∧ b5.ctxParent 1 = some 0 ∧
    b5.ancestorC 0 2 :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩,
    ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩,
    ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S1b, `reject` (Spec 1 §43.3: an active `Modify` descendant): after the
exit, `write3(Y)` via `root_Y` by context 0. The negative twin of S1b is S1a. -/
theorem S1b_2_reject : opStepC KF (.write 0 [0]) 0 b5 .reject :=
  ⟨by decide, _, .reject (by decide), rfl⟩

/-! ## S4, negative twin (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S4) -/

open Ern.Concurrency.Traces in
/-- `a := derive(root_p, Modify)` by context 0 in frame 1 of S4, authority 4 (O1). -/
def q4a : SC := Traces.q4.set (deriveEff (Traces.q4.view 0) 2 [2] .modify)

open Ern.Concurrency.Traces in
/-- The by-value composite of S4 yielding also `a` (WC4 C5). -/
def q5a : SC := spawnValEff q4a 0 [4] [(none, 0)] [(1, 4)]

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S4, negative twin, `reject` (O7.2, as S1a): the composite of S4
yielding also `a := derive(root_p, Modify)` is `ok`, then `exitFrameC(f1)` by context 0 is
rejected, `a` surviving in context 1 without a surviving origin. The positive case is
`Ern.Concurrency.Traces.s4_trace`. -/
theorem S4_2_reject : opStepC K0 (.derive 2 [2] .modify) 0 Traces.q4 (.ok q4a) ∧
    SpawnValStep K0 q4a 0 [4] [(none, 0)] [(1, 4)] (.ok q5a) ∧ opStepC K0 .exit 0 q5a .reject :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩,
    ⟨by decide, .reject (by decide)⟩⟩

/-! ## S13 (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S13) -/

/-- Statics (Spec 1 §47): `0` the local `X` of the base frame, with the leaves `1` (`left`) and `2`
(`right`), `Init`; root authority `0`. -/
def xst : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true)]

/-- Initial state of S13. -/
def t0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init xst)
/-- `a := derive(root_X, Modify)`, authority 1 (O1). -/
def t1 : SC := t0.set (deriveEff (t0.view 0) 0 [1, 2] .modify)
/-- `spawn c1` yielding `a` (WC4 C4): context 1, initial frame 1. -/
def t2 : SC := spawnEff t1 0 [1] []

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S13, `reject` (O10.1: no effective mode, Spec 1 §43.3): after
`spawn c1` yielding `a := derive(root_X, Modify)`, `write3(X)` via `root_X` by context 0. -/
theorem S13_1_reject : opStepC KF (.derive 0 [1, 2] .modify) 0 t0 (.ok t1) ∧
    SpawnStep t1 0 [1] [] (.ok t2) ∧ opStepC KF (.write 0 [1, 2]) 0 t2 .reject :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩,
    ⟨by decide, _, .reject (by decide), rfl⟩⟩

/-- `c1 : release(a)` (O3). -/
def t3 : SC := t2.set (releaseEff (t2.view 1) 1)
/-- `c1 : terminate` (WC4 C7). -/
def t4 : SC := termEffC t3 1
/-- `c0 : write3(X)` via `root_X` (O10). -/
def t5 : SC := t4.set (write3Eff (t4.view 0) [1, 2])

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S13, twin (a), `ok` (Spec 1 §32): `c1 : release(a)`, `terminate`;
`c0 : join(c1)`; `write3(X)` via `root_X`. -/
theorem S13_2_ok : opStepC KF (.release 1) 1 t2 (.ok t3) ∧ TermStep KF t3 1 (.ok t4) ∧
    JoinStep t4 0 1 (.ok t4) ∧ opStepC KF (.write 0 [1, 2]) 0 t4 (.ok t5) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩,
    .ok (by decide) (by decide), ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩⟩

/-- `split(root_X, [left], [right])`: `a1`, authority 1, and `a2`, authority 2 (O2). -/
def u1 : SC := t0.set (splitEff (t0.view 0) 0 [[1], [2]])
/-- `spawn c1` yielding `a1` (WC4 C4). -/
def u2 : SC := spawnEff u1 0 [1] []
/-- `c0 : write3(right)` via `a2` (O10). -/
def u3 : SC := u2.set (write3Eff (u2.view 0) [2])

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S13, twin (b), `ok` (O2, structural disjointness; Spec 1 §23, §85):
`split(root_X, [left], [right])`, `spawn c1` yielding `a1`, then `write3(right)` via `a2` by
context 0. -/
theorem S13_3_ok : opStepC KF (.split 0 [[1], [2]]) 0 t0 (.ok u1) ∧ SpawnStep u1 0 [1] [] (.ok u2) ∧
    opStepC KF (.write 2 [2]) 0 u2 (.ok u3) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩,
    ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩⟩

/-! ## S14 (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S14) -/

/-- Initial state of S14: the local `X` (place 0), `Init`, root authority 0 (statics of S1b). -/
def v0 : SC := SC.ofS3 (S3.init yst)
/-- `o1 := derive(root_X, Observe)`, authority 1 (O1). -/
def v1 : SC := v0.set (deriveEff (v0.view 0) 0 [0] .observe)
/-- `o2 := derive(root_X, Observe)`, authority 2 (O1). -/
def v2 : SC := v1.set (deriveEff (v1.view 0) 0 [0] .observe)
/-- `spawn c1` yielding `o1` (WC4 C4): context 1, initial frame 1. -/
def v3 : SC := spawnEff v2 0 [1] []

/-- The setup of S14. -/
theorem s14_setup : opStepC KF (.derive 0 [0] .observe) 0 v0 (.ok v1) ∧
    opStepC KF (.derive 0 [0] .observe) 0 v1 (.ok v2) ∧ SpawnStep v2 0 [1] [] (.ok v3) :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩, ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩,
    ⟨by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S14, step 1, `ok` (O9, Spec 1 §21, §50): `read3(X)` via `o2` by
context 0. -/
theorem S14_1_ok : opStepC KF (.read 2 [0]) 0 v3 (.ok (v3.set (v3.view 0))) :=
  ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S14, step 2, `ok` (O9, Spec 1 §21, §50): `read3(X)` via `o1` by
context 1. -/
theorem S14_2_ok : opStepC KF (.read 1 [0]) 1 v3 (.ok (v3.set (v3.view 1))) :=
  ⟨by decide, _, .ok (by decide), rfl⟩

/-- `corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S14, negative twin, `reject` (O1.2: the effective mode of `root_X` is
reduced to `Observe`, Spec 1 §43.4; O1.3, I1): `derive(root_X, Modify)` by context 0 while `o1` is
active. -/
theorem S14_3_reject : opStepC KF (.derive 0 [0] .modify) 0 v3 .reject ∧
    effective v3.flat 0 0 = some .observe :=
  ⟨⟨by decide, _, .reject (by decide), rfl⟩, by decide⟩

end Ern.Concurrency.Corpus

import Ern.Concurrency.Corpus.MX

/-!
# Corpus of milestone 3, case S10

`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S10: from `MX₃`, context 0 acquires the grant `g` (held by frame 0), enters
`f1` yielding `m := derive(root_M, Modify)` with a local `M′` of the shape of `M`, and in `f1`
transfers `M` into `M′`. The corpus expects `reject` (O4.7). In the model the step is `ok`
(`S10_1_ok`): the re-indexed §63.7 (`TransferPreC.anchorOrderHeld`) reads `AnchorOrderHeld` on the
moved authorities held by places, and `g` is held by frame 0. The theorem records the state the
corpus describes (the effective anchor of `g` is now in `f1`, which is not an ancestor of frame 0)
and that the exit of `f1` is then rejected. This disagreement is a result, reported, not resolved.
-/

namespace Ern.Concurrency.Corpus

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Concurrency
open Ern.Concurrency.Traces (L0)

/-- `c0 : acquire(e)` in `MX₃`: `g`, authority 4, held by frame 0 (WC4 C16). -/
def r1 : SC := deriveSyncEff x2 0 3
/-- `m := derive(root_M, Modify, footprint(M))`, authority 5 (O1). -/
def r2 : SC := r1.set (deriveEff (r1.view 0) 0 [1, 2] .modify)
/-- `enterFrame f1` yielding `m`, with the local `M′` (place 7, fields 8 and 9, `Uninit`) (O6). -/
def r3 : SC := enterEffC r2 0 [5] [(none, 0), (some 7, 0), (some 7, 0)]
/-- `f1 : transfer(M, M′)` (O4). -/
def r4 : SC := transferEffC r3 0 0 7

/-- The setup of S10 (`corpus-spec2-m3.md` §1 S10): `acquire(e)` by context 0, `derive`, then
`enterFrame f1` yielding `m` with the local `M′`. -/
theorem s10_setup : AcquireOk KM L0 x2 regX 0 0 (r1, [⟨3, some 4⟩]) ∧

/-- Pointer soundness of `store` executed by `c` (Spec 1 §82.2 pointer validity and its last
sentence, §82.3; WC4 C2, C25), at the grain of abstract steps: under `ReprC`, `FramesC`, `WF3` and
`NoDangling` of the globally live frames, an `ok` step of `store(authority, target)` executed by

and the obligation of the encoding for that reference: the conclusions of

`Refinement.pointer_sound_store`, which reads §65.1 (the authority is active) and §65.2 (the
target is a usable leaf) only. -/

    {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s s' : SC} {m : Machine.State} {c a p ad : Nat}

    (h : opStepC k (.store a p) c s (.ok s')) (had : ptrAddr m L (s.view c) a = ad)

    pe.decode (bytesOf (run m (storeOps (Ty := Ty) pe m L ty (s.view c) a p)) L p) = ad ∧
      (∀ i, i < (L p).len →
        (bytesOf (run m (storeOps (Ty := Ty) pe m L ty (s.view c) a p)) L p i).2 =
          some (anchorAlloc L (s.view c) a)) ∧

        AllocP m (L l).alloc fun al => al.live = true ∧ (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ al.size) ∧
      ((∀ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, (L l).len = 0) → ad = baseOf m (anchorAlloc L (s.view c) a)) ∧
      ((∃ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, 0 < (L l).len) → ∃ l ∈ (s.view c).afp a, 0 < (L l).len ∧
        ad = leafAddr m L l ∧ ∀ l' ∈ (s.view c).afp a, 0 < (L l').len → ad ≤ leafAddr m L l') := by

    mem_footprint.2 ⟨hpre.usable.lt, hpre.leaf, hpre.usable.lt, .inl rfl⟩⟩

allocation of a leaf that is pinned, when no leaf of a place dying with the frame is pinned

current frame) and §73.3 only. -/
theorem exit_keeps_pinned {Ty : Type} {k : K} {π : Refinement.Params Ty} {t : S3}
    {m : Machine.State} (hR : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok t m) (hw : WF3 t) (hF : t.F ≠ [])
    {l : Nat} (hl : l < t.P.length) (hlf : isLeaf t.P l)

    (hnp : ∀ q ∈ List.range t.P.length, t.Usable q → ¬ ({ t with F := t.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ l ∈ footprint t.P q, t.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l)
    (hlive : LiveAlloc m (π.L l).alloc) :
    LiveAlloc (run m (exitOps (Ty := Ty) π.L π.rtok t)) (π.L l).alloc := by
  have hpw : (exitRoots t).Pairwise (fun r r' => (π.L r).alloc ≠ (π.L r').alloc) :=
    ((range_pairwise _).filter _).imp_of_mem fun {r r'} hr hr' hlt =>
      hR.inj r r' (mem_exitRoots.1 hr).1 (mem_exitRoots.1 hr').1 (Nat.ne_of_lt hlt)
  have hlv : ∀ r ∈ exitRoots t, AllocP m (π.L r).alloc
      fun a => a.live = true ∧ a.freeAuth = some (π.rtok r) := fun r hr =>
    (hR.live r (mem_exitRoots.1 hr).1 (exitRoots_dies hw hF hr).1).and
      (hR.tokens r (mem_exitRoots.1 hr).1)
  obtain ⟨-, hkeep, -⟩ := deallocOps_run (Ty := Ty) (C := fun _ _ => True)
    (ObR := ⟨fun _ _ _ => True, fun _ _ _ => True⟩)
    (ObW := ⟨fun _ _ _ _ => True, fun _ _ _ _ => True⟩) (fun _ => trivial) _ m hpw hlv
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hla⟩ := hlive
  refine ⟨a, ?_, hla⟩
  change (run m (deallocOps (Ty := Ty) π.L π.rtok (exitRoots t))).allocs _ = _
  rw [hkeep _ fun r hr e => hpinned ?_, ha]
  obtain ⟨hdu, hdn⟩ := exitRoots_dies hw hF hr
  have hfp := hR.leaf_of_alloc hw hl hlf (mem_exitRoots.1 hr).1 e.symm
  exact hnp r (List.mem_range.2 (mem_exitRoots.1 hr).1.1) hdu hdn l hfp

/-- **`pinned_address_stable` under `ReprC`** (Spec 1 §82.6, §74, §75; §63.5, §69.4, §70.4,
§73.3; WC4 C2, C7, C25), extension of R1 at the grain of abstract steps: for every labelled step
from a state satisfying `KInvCA`, a leaf covered by an active dynamic pinning obligation or pinned
by `K.Pinned`, whose allocation is live before the step, keeps a live allocation and the same
address after the raw operations realizing the step. -/
theorem pinned_address_stableC {Ty : Type} {k : K} {L : MutexLayout} {π : Refinement.Params Ty}
    {w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat} {lbl : Label} {st st' : SC × SyncReg × ArenaReg}
    {m : Machine.State} (hR : ReprC π.L π.rtok st.1 m) (hk : KInvCA st.1)
    (h : LStep k L lbl st st') {l : Nat} (hl : l < st.1.P.length) (hlf : isLeaf st.1.P l)
    (hpin : (∃ (o : Nat) (ob : PinOb), st.1.pins[o]? = some ob ∧ ob.active = true ∧
      l ∈ ob.leaves) ∨ k.Pinned l)
    (hlive : LiveAlloc m (π.L l).alloc) :
    LiveAlloc (run m (realize π w lbl st.1 st.2.2 m)) (π.L l).alloc ∧
      leafAddr (run m (realize π w lbl st.1 st.2.2 m)) π.L l = leafAddr m π.L l := by
  have hwf := hR.adm.wf
  refine ⟨?_, by simp only [leafAddr]; rw [baseOf_run hwf _ (hlive.mono fun _ _ => trivial)]⟩
  have hnod : ∀ ops : List (Machine.Op Ty), (∀ o ∈ ops, NoDealloc o) →
      LiveAlloc (run m ops) (π.L l).alloc := fun ops hn => live_run _ _ hwf hn hlive
  have hpinned : ∀ c, ¬ ((st.1.view c).pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) := fun c ⟨h1, h2⟩ => by
    rcases hpin with h | h
    · rw [S3.pin_iff.2 h] at h1; cases h1
    · exact h2 h
  cases h with
  | @kernel s s' reg ar c op h =>
    have hpv := view_facts hk c
    cases op
    case transfer => exact hnod _ (copyOps_noDealloc _ _ _ _)
    case store => exact hnod _ (writeOps_noDealloc _ _ _ _ _)
    case enter => exact hnod _ (allocOps_noDealloc _ _ _ _ _ _)
    case depend => exact hnod _ fun _ h => nomatch h
    case exit =>
      obtain ⟨-, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨hpre, -⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
      have hFv : (s.view c).F ≠ [] := by
        intro he
        have hc : s.stk c ≠ [] := fun e => hpre.hasCaller (by rw [e]; rfl)
        obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hc

  · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7, h8, h9, h10, h11, h12, h13⟩, h14⟩
    refine ⟨by rw [hv]; exact h1, by rw [hv]; exact h2, h3, by rw [hv]; exact h4, h5,
      by rw [hf]; exact h6, by rw [hf]; exact h7, by rw [hf]; exact h8, by rw [hf]; exact h9,
      by rw [hf]; exact h10, (single_anchorOrderC hs hd).2 h11,
      (single_anchorOrderHeldC hs hd).2 h12, by rw [hf]; exact h13, by rw [hf]; exact h14⟩

/-- Theorem 1 for `newArena` (WC4 C24; Spec 1 §76, §58): on a single-context state with the frame
structure `FramesC`, `newArena` executed by the context has exactly the outcomes of
`Arena.NewArenaStep` on the projection, the synchronization registry being the other registry of
live administrations. -/
theorem conservative_newArena (hs : s.Single) (hfr : FramesC s) (reg : SyncReg) (ar : ArenaReg)
    (st i : Nat) :
    (∀ o, NewArenaStepC s reg ar 0 st i o →
      Arena.NewArenaStep [liveGuardeds s reg] st i ⟨s.toS3, ar⟩ (omap projL o)) ∧
    (∀ o₃, Arena.NewArenaStep [liveGuardeds s reg] st i ⟨s.toS3, ar⟩ o₃ →
      ∃ o, NewArenaStepC s reg ar 0 st i o ∧ omap projL o = o₃) := by
  have hp := newArenaPreC_single hs hfr reg ar st i
  refine ⟨fun o ⟨_, h⟩ => ?_, fun o₃ h => ?_⟩
  · cases h with
    | ok hpre => exact Guarded.ok (hp.1 hpre)
    | reject hn => exact Guarded.reject fun h => hn (hp.2 h)
  · cases h with
    | ok hpre => exact ⟨_, ⟨single_live hs, .ok (hp.2 hpre)⟩, rfl⟩
    | reject hn => exact ⟨_, ⟨single_live hs, .reject fun h => hn (hp.1 h)⟩, rfl⟩

/-- Writing back kernel components with the same frame counter keeps `FramesC` (WC4 C3, C20). -/
theorem framesC_set {t : S3} (hn : t.nF = s.nF) (hfr : FramesC s) : FramesC (s.set t) :=
  ⟨hfr.initial, hfr.nonempty, hfr.nodup,
    fun f hf => by show f < t.nF; rw [hn]; exact hfr.bound f hf, hfr.rooted, hfr.parent⟩

/-- An `ok` `split` of the context of a single-context state writes back the `split` of its view
(Spec 1 §61 effect), and keeps a single-context state with the frame structure `FramesC`. -/
theorem split_single {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} {s₁ : SC} (hs : s.Single)
    (h : opStepC k (.split src rs) 0 s (.ok s₁)) :
    s₁ = s.set (splitEff (s.view 0) src rs) ∧ s₁.Single := by
  obtain ⟨t, hR, rfl⟩ := SyncPreserveAux.viewStep_ok h
  have hR' : SplitStep k src rs (s.view 0) (.ok t) := hR
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hR'
  exact ⟨rfl, hs⟩

/-- Theorem 1 for `issue` (WC4 C24; Spec 1 §77, §58, Part XIV): on a single-context state with
the frame structure `FramesC`, `issue` executed by the context has exactly the outcomes of the
derived operation `Arena.IssueD` on the projection, outcome by outcome, `fail` included. -/
theorem conservative_issue (hs : s.Single) (hfr : FramesC s) (ar : ArenaReg) (i : Nat)
    (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    (∀ o, IssueStepC k s ar 0 i region dst o →
      Arena.IssueD k i region dst ⟨s.toS3, ar⟩ (omap projL o)) ∧
    (∀ o₃, Arena.IssueD k i region dst ⟨s.toS3, ar⟩ o₃ →
      ∃ o, IssueStepC k s ar 0 i region dst o ∧ omap projL o = o₃) := by
  have hv := single_view hs
  have hst_iff : ∀ E, Arena.IssueStatic (s.view 0) E region dst ↔
      Arena.IssueStatic s.toS3 E region dst := fun E => by rw [hv]
  have hlive := single_live hs
    obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hrl
    obtain ⟨x, hx, -⟩ := hp.active
    rw [releaseEff_eq hx]; rfl

/-- Theorem 1 for `reset` (WC4 C24; Spec 1 §78, §58, Part XIV): on a single-context state,
`reset` executed by the context has exactly the outcomes of the derived operation `Arena.ResetD`
on the projection, outcome by outcome. -/
theorem conservative_reset (hs : s.Single) (ar : ArenaReg) (i : Nat) :
    (∀ o, ResetStepC s ar 0 i o → Arena.ResetD i ⟨s.toS3, ar⟩ (omap projL o)) ∧
    (∀ o₃, Arena.ResetD i ⟨s.toS3, ar⟩ o₃ → ∃ o, ResetStepC s ar 0 i o ∧ omap projL o = o₃) := by
  have hv := single_view hs
  have back : ∀ o₃, Arena.ResetD i ⟨s.toS3, ar⟩ o₃ →
      omap projL (omap (fun L' : Arena.LState => (s.set L'.kern, L'.arenas)) o₃) = o₃ := by
    intro o₃ h
    cases o₃ with
    | ok L' =>
      have hF := resetD_F h
      show Outcome3.ok (⟨(s.set L'.kern).toS3, L'.arenas⟩ : Arena.LState) = .ok L'
      rw [toS3_set hF]
    | reject => rfl
    | fail => rfl
  refine ⟨fun o ⟨_, o₃, h, ho⟩ => ?_, fun o₃ h => ⟨_, ⟨single_live hs, o₃, ?_, rfl⟩, back o₃ h⟩⟩
  · have h' : Arena.ResetD i ⟨s.toS3, ar⟩ o₃ := by rw [← hv]; exact h
    rw [ho, back o₃ h']; exact h'
  · rw [hv]; exact h

end Single

/-- R5 for the arena operations (WC4 C24; Spec 1 §82.7): on a single-context state, the
realization of `newArena`, `issue` and `reset` executed by the context is the realization
`RefinementArena.lopsOf` of the corresponding library operation on the projection. -/
theorem r5_arena {Ty : Type} (π : Refinement.Params Ty) (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)
    {s : SC} (hs : s.Single) (ar : ArenaReg) (m : Machine.State) (others : List (List Nat))
    (st i dst : Nat) (region : List Nat) :
    realize π w (.newArena 0 st i) s ar m =
        RefinementArena.lopsOf π (.newArena others st i) ⟨s.toS3, ar⟩ m ∧
      realize π w (.issue 0 i region dst) s ar m =
        RefinementArena.lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) ⟨s.toS3, ar⟩ m ∧
      realize π w (.reset 0 i) s ar m = RefinementArena.lopsOf π (.reset i) ⟨s.toS3, ar⟩ m := by
  have hv := single_view hs
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [realize, RefinementArena.lopsOf, RefinementArena.kexp]
    cases ar[i]? with
    | none => rfl
    | some E =>
      dsimp only
      rw [SC.view_set (s := s) (c := 0) (t := splitEff (s.view 0) E.internal [region]) rfl, hv]
      simp [RefinementArena.ktrace, kopOf]
      rfl
  · simp only [realize, RefinementArena.lopsOf, RefinementArena.kexp]
    cases ar[i]? with
